sentence: This project uses artificial intelligence to examine data on millions of Veterans and their medications to find drugs that may delay the start of dementia.
This project covers light-based tools and techniques used to study brain structure and function, with a focus on neurovascular physiology.
This project uses explainable artificial intelligence and real-world data to help design eligibility criteria for Alzheimer's disease trials, and builds a web-based tool for this.
This project studies how cells make unusual chemical groups in natural products that work as biological warheads.
This project studies why a type of immune cell that can kill cancer cells instead speeds up the growth of lung cancer.
This project provides tissue slide preparation and microscope imaging services so researchers can study the musculoskeletal system.
This project studies how the pedunculopontine nucleus connects with the basal ganglia, in work on movement problems in Parkinson's disease.
This project collects and stores blood, cerebrospinal fluid and brain scan samples to study how vascular burden relates to Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.
This project builds enzymes that label nearby proteins so researchers can map where proteins sit and interact inside living cells.
This project studies how parents' feeding approaches can help prevent obesity in children who are highly motivated by food.
This project develops digital health and computational tools to screen young children for autism early and to track changes in their behavior.
This project studies how breast milk changes over time and over the day, and how those changes relate to infant sleep and the infant microbiome.
This project studies how personally relevant stressful experiences may lead people to use alcohol and cannabis.
This project studies a basic physical property of a protein that controls gene activity in cancer and stem cell development.
This project builds a simple, rapid imaging tool that shows many RNA molecules at once in cells and tissue.
This project studies genetic variants in human disease genes in zebrafish to find out what they do and how to test them.
This project builds a human muscle cell culture model that recreates the surroundings of muscle stem cells so researchers can study muscle disease and regeneration.
This project studies how mutations in two phospholipase genes help tumors avoid detection by the immune system.
This project tries to change natural killer cells so they can kill several diseased cells at once, and builds ways to watch it.
